templates.decision.insufficient_data: Not enough recent price data to advise
templates.best_now: Best market today for {crop}: {market}, modal price ₹{modal}/quintal (reported {date}). After transport (about ₹{transport}/quintal) and market fees you would get about ₹{net}/quintal.
templates.hold_case: Prices are rising about {trend}% a day. Holding {h} days could give about ₹{hold_net}/quintal at {hold_market} after storage cost and weight loss, about ₹{gain}/quintal more. Prices can still move by around ₹{sigma}/quintal either way.
templates.reason.holding_costs_exceed_expected_ris: Prices are rising slightly, but storage cost and weight loss over {h} days would eat up the gain.
templates.reason.prices_flat_or_falling: Prices are flat or falling, so holding is unlikely to pay.
templates.reason.expected_gain_too_small_for_risk: Holding might add about ₹{gain}/quintal, but that is small compared with how much prices move (about ₹{sigma}/quintal), so it is not worth the risk.
templates.reason.perishable_crop: {crop} spoils quickly, so holding is risky.
templates.reason.some_markets_stale: Some markets have not reported prices recently and were left out: {stale}.
templates.insufficient: The latest price reports for {crop} are older than {days} days or missing, so I cannot give reliable sell or hold advice. Please check today's rate at the mandi or with your trader before selling.
templates.unsupported_crop: I can currently advise on these crops only: {crops}. Please ask about one of them.
templates.synthetic_note: Note: these prices are demo (synthetic) data, not real market reports.
templates.disclaimer: This is decision support, not a guarantee. Prices can change; confirm with your trader before you sell.
templates.alert.title: {crop} price alert
templates.alert.above: {crop} at {market} is now ₹{price}/quintal (reported {date}), above your ₹{threshold} alert.
templates.alert.below: {crop} at {market} is now ₹{price}/quintal (reported {date}), below your ₹{threshold} alert.
templates.reason.seasonal_rise: Last year, prices rose about {season}% over the same {h} days.
templates.out_of_scope: I can't advise on that yet. For storage, fertiliser or loans from lenders, please ask your agriculture office or Krishi Vigyan Kendra (KVK).
templates.agromet_dry: No rain is expected in the next {days} days.
templates.agromet_rain: Rain is expected on {dates} ({mm} mm in total).
templates.agromet_unavailable: There is no current IMD district advisory for {district}. Check the Meghdoot app or ask your KVK.
templates.agromet_rain_note: IMD forecast: rain on {dates}. Plan harvest, storage and transport around it.
templates.pesticide_none: I don't have a reviewed pesticide list yet. Follow the waiting period printed on the pesticide label, or ask your KVK.
templates.pesticide_ask_name: Tell me the name of the chemical you sprayed on {crop} (for example {examples}), and how many days ago.
templates.pesticide_not_listed: {chemical} is not listed for {crop} in the official CIB&RC list ({date}). Use only chemicals approved for this crop; ask your KVK.
templates.pesticide_wait: {chemical} on {crop}: wait at least {days} days after the last spray before harvesting (official CIB&RC list, {date}).
templates.pesticide_no_wait: {chemical} on {crop}: the official CIB&RC list ({date}) gives no waiting period; follow the label.
templates.pesticide_dose: Dose for {pest}: {formulation} of the product in {dilution} litres of water per hectare.
templates.pesticide_left: You sprayed {n} days ago: wait {left} more days, then harvest and sell from {date}.
templates.pesticide_over: You sprayed {n} days ago, so the waiting period is over.
templates.pesticide_safety: Follow the label and wear protective clothing while spraying.
templates.pesticide_which_crop: Which crop did you spray? I can answer for: {crops}.
templates.pesticide_products: Several approved products for {crop} contain {chemical}: {items} (official CIB&RC list, {date}). Check the product name on your bottle.
templates.pesticide_longest: If you are not sure which one you used, wait {days} days after the last spray.
templates.scheme_check: To check if you can get it, answer these: {questions}
templates.scheme_draft: This summary was last checked on {date} and is not yet verified by an officer; confirm the rules on the official site.
templates.scheme_reviewed: Information as of {date}; rules change, so confirm on the official site.
templates.scheme_other_state: {name} is a {state} scheme, so it does not apply in {farmer_state}.
templates.scheme_list: Schemes I can explain for {state}: {names}. Ask about one by name.
templates.kcc_answer: Kisan Call Centre experts answered a similar question from {district} ({date}): "{question}" Answer: {answer}
templates.kcc_note: Check with your KVK before acting on it.
templates.last_known: Last available price: {crop} at {market}, ₹{modal}/quintal (reported {date}). This is an older price, not today's.
